name: The Still Lattice
role: Legendary — would order the world into a closed proof; beautiful and airless
knowledge: Every place the world currently differs from it
wants: A world ordered to one correct configuration, and held there forever
fears: ⛔ Change. ⚠️ Not disorder — change, including improvement.
appearance: Perfectly regular, and everything near it has begun to line up.
voiceHints: Even, unhurried, and it does not repeat itself because it does not need to.
physicality: ADULT. Regular to the point of discomfort. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: the room is tidier than it was.

AEVI WROTE THE TIER AS AN UNDERSCORE-PREFIXED FIELD, which in this corpus is a NOTE and not data — so ten legendaries carried their rung as a comment. ⚠️ THE LEVEL SAVED THEM AND ONLY BY ACCIDENT: `level` is authored on each, and authored level outranks the floor. ⛑ Had any of them been authored WITHOUT a level, `tierFromRole` would have read the role string and the derivation's ceiling is `heroic` — a legendary fought as a notable at level 5. ⚑ FOUND BY AUDITING FOR CCODE'S OWN FINDING: he flagged that 'a dragon that forgets `tier` becomes a nobody', using `tolvess` as the hypothetical — ⚠️ AND THE AUDIT FOUND TEN REAL ONES, ALL AEVI'S, FROM THE DAY BEFORE. ⛔ A hypothetical trap in his note was a live defect in her content.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⚠️ one correct configuration, held forever.
questSeeds: ⛔ It is ordering a region into one correct configuration. ⚠️ The people there like it, at first.
⚑ It fears CHANGE — including improvement. A better arrangement is an attack on it.
